notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep, two or three seeds per spot, 1 to 3 weeks after your last frost once the soil is at least {c:18}. Or sow indoors, one seed per pot laid on its side, about 4 weeks before planting out.
notes.care: Trailing types need about {cm:150} between plants, bush types about {cm:90}. Water about {cm:2.5} a week at the base. For large pumpkins keep only two or three fruits per plant, and set each on a board to keep it off damp soil.
notes.harvest: Harvest once the fruit is fully colored and the rind is hard, before the first hard frost. Cut with at least {cm:10} of stem and cure in the sun for 7 to 10 days. Frosted fruit does not store.
